title: California, Oregon Coast Guard crews rescue 6 from sailboat taking on water 80 miles west of Crescent City
description: A Coast Guard Sector Humboldt Bay MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew hoists four survivors from their 79-foot sailboat after it began taking on water 80 miles west of Crescent City, California, June 19, 2021. Sector Humboldt Bay was aided by a Coast Guard Sector North Bend, Oregon, MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew who hoisted the remaining two survivors and transported them to safety. (U. S. Coast Guard courtesy video)
